objective: Select the best model using validation-only tuning, then evaluate exactly once on the untouched fixed test split.

data_protocol.test_policy: test is not read for model or hyperparameter selection

stage_1_hyperparameter_tuning.budget_policy: coarse validation-only search followed by local refinement around the best configuration

stage_2_optimization.selection_rule: validation macro_f1 first; balanced_accuracy as tie-breaker; calibration and compute reported separately

stage_4_confirmation.test_evaluation: only locked final candidate and baselines, after all choices are frozen

evidence_gates: no test metric used during selection
failed or inaccessible kernels remain marked unverified
publication_boundary: Until Phase 24 and confirmation artifacts pass all gates, existing Phase 20/21 numbers remain fixed-protocol benchmark results, not claims of best achievable performance.
